AK_EXUSIAI_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_AMMO.title: Ammo
AK_EXUSIAI_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_AMMO.descr: Each actual damage hit of an Attack spends 1 Ammo and gains bonus damage based on the Ammo count before the card was played (+1 per 5 Ammo, minimum +2). Ammo is capped at 30; reaching the cap enters Overload. During Overload, Ammo cannot be gained or spent and Attack damage is increased by 50%. At end of turn, lose all Ammo and exit Overload.
